title: The Half-Light Interior
author: Cyrus Whitlock
blurb: August Thackeray, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
